notes: The platform has four named pillars: Runtime Governance, Runtime Control, Runtime Security and the Assurance Layer, all fed by the Singulr Pulse risk engine. A July 2026 release extended Agent Pulse to endpoint agents (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT Desktop), MCP, LiteLLM gateways and a Singulr SDK (BusinessWire, 29 Jul 2026), and put Singulr on AWS Marketplace. The pages read say 'all agentic platforms' but do not name Copilot Studio or Agentforce, so 2.1 rests on that general claim. Runtime Governance lists dataset licensing validation and model lineage. Two searches each for NHI, model file scanning and AI SAST found nothing.
